decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight sits close to the firm's core lighting know-how and has kept its own page for two years, so the firm can read its results and improve it within its existing system competence.
The LED ceiling luminaire builds directly on established design and LED knowledge and has kept a dedicated page since 2023, which points to a stable place in the range.
The flexible LED spotlight is a close extension of the existing spotlight families, so the firm can absorb early feedback from dealers and planners and refine it.
The multi-outlet canopy extends the modular system logic the firm already masters and supports flexible configurations that customers value, so the firm should keep it.
The low-voltage canopy relies on related system knowledge, but its narrower niche makes it somewhat riskier, though it still fits the modular offer.
The round glass track luminaires fit the track system and firm know-how, but appearing only as a website mention suggests lower visibility and a higher chance of being pruned from the range.
